rationale: Record teaching the runtime materializer and the baked C++ emitter the figma resize constraints (h_constraint/v_constraint) and grid track flow (grid_auto_flow) that only the script lane lowered, so a right-pinned or centered node landed pinned in a script bundle and flush-left at runtime and in every exported plugin. The mapping moves into one shared resolve_layout_constraints() the script lane is also refactored onto, so three lanes read one definition instead of one lane owning a private copy. Takes the two tokens rather than the whole IRLayout so each lane still names the fields at its call site and stays visible to the cross-surface parity ledger. Watch-only: no design-import or rendering authority is transferred, the engine capabilities used (auto-unit margins, percentage minimums, GridStyle::parse_auto_flow) already existed, and no field that was already lowered changes behavior.
tests: native materializer lowers figma resize constraints onto flex
baked C++ emits figma resize constraints and grid auto-flow
generate_pulp_cpp emits the public layout and visual-style surface
